findings.text: Independent Opus review pass_with_notes, 0 blocking: all five required mutations turned the selftest red (drop a run -> red; force classification active; tokens 0 instead of unknown; blocked-elapsed folded away; a write during read), reverted to green. Read-only proven by a byte-identical snapshot; burn-down confirmed to reuse plan.py (matches the index).

Minor follow-up (non-blocking): status() accepts now_epoch but threads it only into heartbeat-age display; classification via list_runs/classify uses wall-clock time. Not exercised by any shipped path; tighten when convenient.

summary: R3 (WARP-0503, warp status and warp watch) is correct and honest. Independent adversarial review pass_with_notes, 0 blocking; gate GREEN (selftest 817). A read-only reader projects git, the durable event stream, and the R1 registry into one model, classifying each run and surfacing the blocked question and blocked-elapsed separately from human_minutes, with tokens shown unknown not estimated; five mutations proven to turn the selftest red and the reader proven to write nothing. status_reader mechanical is honest; the burn-down reuses plan.py so it cannot drift from the index. proof_digest via validate.py.
